name: Hyphal Extension
effect: Grow 1 step: toward all food sources in range.
flavor: Apical tips elongate by turgor pressure, fanning out to colonise every nearby crumb of litter.
notes: GLOBAL targeting (no tap). The backbone of the starting deck (run 4-6 copies). Maps to actions.grow; play is FREE (you paid drawCostEnergy 8 to draw it). The OMNIDIRECTIONAL forage member of the grow trio: spreads to all sensed attractors. Pairs against Apical Drive (player-aimed single direction) and Foraging Fan (radial 1-step). No goal-pathing (R8) — it follows sensed attractors, not the goal. familyKey:basics.

name: Leaf Litter Cache
effect: Pick a direction; drop a SMALL nutrient patch at the edge of sensing range.
flavor: Saprotrophs pre-position on a thin scatter of decaying leaf litter, seeding the next colonisation front.
notes: DIRECTIONAL targeting; patchSize=small (R3: patch dropped at sensing-range EDGE in chosen direction, player picks direction NOT distance). Smallest member of the substrate size family (small->medium->large). Maps to actions.addSubstrate, play FREE. Strong EARLY for routing a Grow where you want; near-dud LATE (no time to grow into it). Not auto-include: wasted if no follow-up Grow is queued. familyKey:basics.

name: Apical Drive
effect: Grow 1 step: choose a direction.
flavor: Hyphae lock onto a single advance heading, ramming the front across open ground in one committed line.
notes: DIRECTIONAL targeting; growthAmount=1 cycle along the player-aimed vector. Replaces the CUT Chemotropic Probe but is player-AIMED (R8) — the player picks the direction, NOT 'toward the goal' and NOT obstacle-pathing. Genuine straight-vs-branch tradeoff with Hyphal Extension: committing to a heading skips off-axis side piles, so neither dominates. Best EARLY for crossing a known open gap. familyKey:basics.

name: Foraging Fan
effect: Grow 1 step: every direction.
flavor: With no gradient to follow, the colony expands isotropically, a slow even ring of probing tips.
notes: GLOBAL-radial growth trick (R3b: 'grow 1 in every direction, no substrate needed'); growthAmount=1 omnidirectional step. No tap. Distinct from the two reaching grows: shortest reach but unconditional and attractor-free, so it works on a barren stretch where Hyphal Extension stalls for lack of a sensed attractor. Not auto-include: wasteful when a clear attractor or aimed line would carry you further per play. familyKey:basics.

name: Tropic Lunge
effect: Grow 3 steps toward the nearest food source, even if out of range.
flavor: Starved tips strain past their normal sensing horizon, lunging for the faintest trace of nutrient.
notes: FIXED per reviewer (high): removed the self-contradictory fallback ('no attractor sensed, yet grow toward nearest attractor within range'); the card is now UNPLAYABLE when no attractor is sensed (R7 — no do-nothing branch). DIRECTIONAL-to-attractor growth trick (R3b: 'grow 3 toward the nearest sensed substrate even if out of range'); growthAmount=3 toward nearest attractor. Targets the attractor, not the goal (R8). Distinct from Apical Drive (player-aimed) and Hyphal Extension (forage all): this one over-reaches to a single nearest attractor. Not auto-include: greyed out on open ground with no attractor, so you must have a patch/pile in or just past range to fire it. familyKey:basics.

name: Humus Bed
effect: Pick a direction; drop a MEDIUM patch at the edge of sensing range.
flavor: A built-up bed of rotted humus offers a fat, slow-burning meal for the advancing front.
notes: DIRECTIONAL targeting; patchSize=medium (R3: sensing-range edge in chosen direction, direction only). The MIDDLE member of the substrate size family, sitting between Leaf Litter Cache (small) and Mycorrhizal Mat (large). A bigger attractor and a bigger later Digest yield than the small patch, but no reach difference — pure size differentiation per R3. Not auto-include: same routing-dependence as the small patch, just a heavier commit. familyKey:basics.

name: Mycorrhizal Mat
effect: Pick a direction; drop a LARGE patch at the edge of sensing range.
flavor: A symbiotic mat of mycelium and rootlets lays down a broad, nutrient-dense colonisation target.
notes: DIRECTIONAL targeting; patchSize=large (R3: sensing-range edge in chosen direction, direction only). LARGEST member of the substrate size family. Biggest attractor pull and the richest later Digest reservoir, but identical placement rule to the smaller patches (size is the only lever, R3). Best MID when you want to firmly redirect the front or bank fuel for Digest. Not auto-include: overkill for a quick reroute where the small/medium patch suffices, and wasted LATE. familyKey:basics.

name: Saprotrophic Digest
effect: Drain 1 nutrient from every occupied food source, doubling the energy received.
flavor: Secreted cellulases and ligninases break litter into absorbable sugars across the whole colonised mat.
notes: FIXED per reviewer (low): refund realigned to the locked digest base=1 model (R5). Digest base rate = 1 flat nutrient per occupied patch (replaces the old drainFraction 0.5); refund is +1 energy per occupied patch drained — flat, no percentages, scales only with how much substrate you've colonised. GLOBAL targeting (R4: hits ALL occupied substrate, never a specific cell). One-shot energy, NOT an engine (no per-round produce, repayRounds 0) so it cannot break the idle/clock invariant. On a small network (1-5 patches) the refund stays below drawCost 8, so spamming it to draw is net-negative — it only pays off when you have broad substrate you were going to abandon. Relief valve when energy is tight; a waste when you'd rather keep the substrate as a live attractor. familyKey:basics.

name: Appressorial Punch
effect: Grow hyphae through one selected boulder in-range.
flavor: A melanin-walled appressorium builds enormous turgor to drive a penetration peg through the rock — up to ~8 MPa, as in Magnaporthe.
notes: DIRECTIONAL single-rock target: clears the SINGLE nearest in-range BOULDER toward the goal (R6/R8 — the one approved directional rock case; one whole rock, no distance counting, no cell IDs). clears:['boulder'] = Tier-1 dig, the lightest rung of the terrain ladder; formations/columns/lake-basin still need the real P-gated dig events. NO weak-Grow fallback — if no boulder is in range the card is UNPLAYABLE (R6: no do-nothing). Free floor basic, not resource-gated (keeps the basic floor playable when resource-dry). Not auto-include: useless on an open route with no boulder. familyKey:basics.

name: Sclerotial Crust
effect: Tap a point: strands within radius 40 harden — immune to infection and eating for 2 rounds.
flavor: Hyphae aggregate into a hard, melanin-blackened sclerotial rind that pathogens cannot breach.
notes: RADIUS-AROUND-A-TAP targeting; radius=40 (small member of the protect/heal radius family, copying the Amputate radius-60 primitive). Replaces the CUT Septal Plug, which was single-node (R7 — illegal on phone); same reactive-defense identity, now radius-based (R7/R9). Dead card if no threat is near the tapped pocket (NOT auto-include); valuable when a mould cloud or nematode swarm is about to chew your only route. 2-round window forces timing — play too early and immunity lapses before the threat arrives. Free floor basic, ungated. familyKey:basics.

name: Hyphal Imbibition
effect: If your network touches a lake edge, harvest +3 Water. Otherwise gain +1 Water from soil.
flavor: Hyphae draw free water across their walls by simple osmotic imbibition; even dry soil yields a trickle of condensation.
notes: Floor water source, free deck-floor basic (buyCostEnergy 0, R2). GLOBAL targeting: checks whole-network lake adjacency, no tap. Never a full dud (inv. 6/7): +2 lakeside, +1 off-lake, but lakeside double yield keeps routing the point. Below the +3 lake-action so installs stay worth it. Payload of Capillary Runners. You still paid drawCostEnergy 8 to draw it.

name: Phosphate Tap
effect: If your network contacts any mineral, crystal, or boulder, harvest +3 Phosphorus.
flavor: Cords sheathe a rock face and draw down its dissolved phosphate charge.
notes: The basic P HARVEST card the family direction explicitly asks for (parity with the basic W harvest). Free deck-floor; the canonical +3 harvest from CONFIG.resources.harvestPhosphorus. Global contact check (R7, no node/strand targeting). Unplayable when not in contact with a P feature (R6-style: no do-nothing fallback) -> rewards routing to rock first. Rhizomorph Drill upgrades this to +5.

name: Condense
effect: Gain 1 Water.
flavor: Hydrophobic hyphal mats wick dew straight out of the night air.
notes: Free +1 W producer basic, the Water parallel to Mineralize (free +1 P) for W/P/N basic-floor parity. One-shot, not an engine (repay 0). Critical because Water is the scarce one-lake resource; this keeps W-gated cards from being dead on low-lake routing without breaking the harvest economy (only +1, vs +3 lake tap).

name: Rhizomorph Trunkline
effect: Install. Gain +4 energy at the end of each round.
flavor: A melanised rhizomorph - a bundled cable of hyphae that pumps water and nutrients in bulk across long underground runs.
notes: The single biggest per-round energy engine allowed (+4 = the per-engine cap). Pure energy engine: NO W/P/N gate (no double-tax). Flat buy 14, repay 14/4~=3 rounds (uncommon band). CEILING: +4 alone, or +4 (Trunkline) +4-warm (Brown-Rot Mat) handled by the runtime clamp at skip-1=11 -> idle always net-negative. The clamp, not buy cost, is the lever (R12). Distinct from Brown-Rot Mat post-fix: flat +4 forever (steady long-haul anchor) vs Mat's +4-for-3-then-+2 early burst -> Mat better early, Trunkline better as a sustained mid/late cord.

name: Osmotic Cashout
effect: Exhaust (1 Water): gain +22 energy.
flavor: Accumulated glycerol and polyols, drawn in with water, are catabolised in a sudden pulse of metabolic energy.
notes: REVIEWER FIX (medium/dominance): raised from +18 to +22 so the 1-Water gate buys a meaningful premium over the ungated burst counterpart (Hyphal Investment, +18 total spread over 3 rounds, no gate). Clean dominance split now: Cashout = INSTANT, all-at-once, ANY timing, can rescue a one-round liquidity crisis, but spends a scarce Water + competes with growth/dig cards for it (sequencing tension); Hyphal Investment = FREE but slow drip, EARLY only, cannot bail you out instantly. One-shot event, NOT an engine -> repayRounds 0, no idle interaction (can't tick), exempt from the energy ceiling. Targeting global (resolves on play, no tap). Renamed from Turgor Surge.

name: Septal Pore Flux
effect: Install. Drawing a basic card costs 3 less energy.
flavor: Cytoplasm streams freely through the septal pores between hyphal compartments, ferrying material to the growing front at low cost.
notes: R11: dropped the 'does not stack' clause (one unique copy). Savings engine, NOT idle income -> produces 0 energy while card-dry (nothing to draw), EXEMPT from the energy-ceiling sum, never touches the idle-negative invariant. At ~1.5 draws/round it saves ~4.5 energy-equiv/round -> repay 14/~5~=3 rounds (common band). Pairs with extenders; useless once the deck depletes (LATE) -> strong early, dead late. Pure savings: no W/P/N gate.

name: Aquaporin Channels
effect: Install. Gain +1 Water at the end of each round.
flavor: Membrane aquaporins gate a passive flux of water into the growing front until the channels foul and clog.
notes: GLOBAL resource engine (produces W, exempt from energy SUM ceiling, inv. 3; produce.energy 0 so no double-tax flag inv. 4). Lifetime cap 8 makes it strictly EARLY: install LATE and you waste most of the cap before card-dry (real 'too late' read). Repay 4 = flat 14 / ~3.5 resourceValueEquiv, standard band 4-5 (inv. 5). Capped output removes 'prints forever' dominance over the uncapped uncommon below.

name: Phosphatase Cushion
effect: Install. Gain +1 Phosphorus at the end of each round.
flavor: Secreted acid phosphatases cleave bound phosphate from soil minerals until the readily-accessible reserve is exhausted.
notes: Floor P engine with a HARD LIFETIME CAP of 8 P to kill the auto-include profile (R5 flat cap, no %). Flat buy 14; +1 P/round (~3.5 ev) -> repays in the common/early band only if installed early enough to drain the full 8-P reserve. Bought late, it yields only ~4-5 P before the goal -> 'too late to repay', restoring the early-or-trap read. Pure resource engine -> energy-ceiling EXEMPT (no produce.energy), no W/P/N gate (no double-tax). Global production, no targeting (R7).

name: Mineralizing Saprobe
effect: Install. Gain +1 Nitrogen at the end of each round.
flavor: Saprobes break down dead matter into ammonium, the colony's steady nitrogen baseline.
notes: The unconditional common +1 N/round producer so N-gated cards are never dead on worm-light levels. GLOBAL (whole network), no targeting tap. Resource engine = exempt from energy ceiling, produces NO energy. +1 N ~3.5 ev -> repay 4 (standard band). The reliable N spine; the ONLY pure-unconditional N engine in the family (Ammonifying Worm Bloom is worm-conditional, Nematophagous Mat has a worm-defense rider) so no duplicate non-decision at a pile. Not flashy, never auto-include because it competes with the conditional traps for the same N role.

produces: +1 cleared formation/column per round it has a target (~5 energy-equiv of barrier bypass)
effect: Install (2 Phosphorus to play). Every 5 rounds, you may clear an in-range rock formation or column.
flavor: A dominant downward cord - the fungal analogue of a tap-root - probes deep to undermine and crack obstacles.
notes: R2 buy 14, repay 4 (uncommon band 4-5). R6: TIER-3 dig ENGINE, clears=[formation,column], whole-rock per round. UNPLAYABLE with no eligible rock in range. 2 PHOSPHORUS gate (tier-3 P-ladder). GROWTH/routing engine, no produce.energy => EXEMPT from energy ceiling. clears formation,column. targeting directional.

name: Constricting Ring
effect: Install. Action (once per 6 rounds): tap a point where no nematode is within range; the next nematode to enter a small radius is snared and digested for +2 Nitrogen.
flavor: A three-celled ring inflates in a tenth of a second via turgor, throttling the passing nematode (Drechslerella brochopaga).
notes: R7: RADIUS-around-a-tap (small radius 40). Free deck-floor basic (buyCostEnergy 0). +2 N matches eat-a-worm yield. ACTIVE constriction trap (distinct from adhesive-glue lineage). Dud on a clean map, strong where worms roam = placement-dependent, never auto-include. Extenders can flood worm-heavy decks with these.

name: Rehydration Pulse
effect: Exhaust (1 Water): tap a point; heal all worm/mould damage within radius 60.
flavor: A flush of water re-pressurizes collapsed hyphae, reviving rotted and worm-bitten strands.
notes: RADIUS-around-a-tap, not per-strand (R7/R9). Uses the canonical Amputate radius 60 (small heal); declares radius 60. Cheap reactive water sink (1 W). Defense vs mould/worm. Dead on a clean board, never an auto-include (inv. 7). ANY timing, pays immediately, event repay 0. Threat 'all' (repairs any-source damage). Bottom of the radius-heal family (Rehydration 60 -> Monsoon 160), differentiated by RADIUS SIZE only.

name: Nutrient Transmutation
effect: Install. Action (once per round): spend 2 of one resource (W/P/N) to gain 1 of another.
flavor: The colony reroutes its metabolism, trading one assimilated nutrient pool for another it needs more.
notes: The generic W<->P<->N converter at a loss (2->1) so a card gated on a map-absent resource is never fully dead. GLOBAL on stockpiles, no targeting. Lives in the nitrogen family as its N-routing utility. Action cooldown 1, repay 0. 2->1 loss keeps hoarding weak (soft cap 6 still bites) so it's a relief valve, not an engine. Situational = not auto-include.

name: Rhizomorph Lance

flavor: A rhizomorph — a rope of bundled hyphae — shoots ahead as a pre-built transport cord.
notes: Pure distance tempo, W-gated 2, flat 14. Directional growth (R3b/R8): player aims the vector, NOT toward-the-goal pathing. growthAmount 6. Great mid to close on a far pile; weak early, risky late if it overshoots. The single mobility extend (the goal-finisher extend is Fruiting Vigil, distinct payoff). repayRounds 0.

flavor: The colony pours everything into a single primordium, racing to fruit before the soil runs dry.
notes: The premier endgame swing: closes a near-final gap and skips the surface-and-fruit steps. Heavy mixed W 2 + N 2 gate forces resource sequencing; dead weight any time you are not within ~8 cells of the goal (no auto-include). Directional extend the player aims at the goal zone (R8: player-aimed, the one finisher case, not obstacle-pathing). growthAmount 8. flat-14 buy. targeting directional. repayRounds 0.

name: Sclerotial Seal
effect: Install. Action (spend 1 P, once per 3 rounds): tap a food pile; for 3 rounds ants cannot harvest any leaves from it.
flavor: The colony crusts the cache in a hard sclerotial rind; the raiding column mills at the seal and carries nothing home.
notes: REPLACES Fungus-Garden Mat (removed: ants only steal from FOOD PILES, so 'turning back ants touching the network' did nothing). Protects the thing ants actually attack — locks a chosen pile for 3 rounds so the column steals 0 leaves from it. ACTION type, so per the directive it costs P (ATP) to activate: playCostPhosphorus 1 each use. CADENCE FIX (adversarial): cooldown raised from 2 to 3 so protection window (3) and cooldown (3) match and coverage cannot fully overlap — it mitigates single-pile ant maps rather than permanently sealing one pile for a trivial 1 P; forces rotation/tradeoff when multiple piles are threatened. Buy 10 (below the old 16 engine — the P gate + cadence is the second cost per BUY-COST REBALANCE). Produces no resource -> energy-ceiling exempt, produces "". RADIUS-free single-pile tap (R7-safe: target a pile, not 'N nearest strands'). Situational: dead on ant-free maps and needs a threatened pile worth sealing, so never auto-include; strong on ant-heavy food-economy maps. Distinct from Picket Hyphae (flat pile-theft reduction) and Aphid Ranch (ant->energy).

name: Suberin Wall
produces: defense (network-wide: cures 1 infected strand/round and blocks new mould infection)
effect: Install. Each round, network-wide: cure 1 infected strand and stop mould clouds from infecting any new strand. Idles when no mould is present.
flavor: Corky suberin laid down through every cell wall seals the whole colony against Trichoderma's enzymes at once.
notes: REPLACES Melanized Sheath (removed: 'the 3 strands nearest a cloud' was impossible to define/target). GLOBAL, network-wide (R7-safe: no per-strand and no 'N nearest' selection) — the whole network is hardened and one infected strand is cured each round. Kept as an ENGINE (passive/round) like the card it replaces, so it stays out of the action-P rule (only Constricting Ring, Nutrient Transmutation-now-exempt, Sclerotial Vault, Oxalate Barrage are the P-gated actions; this pays no P). Ungated like other defensive commons (no double-tax); produces defense not a resource -> energy-ceiling exempt (produce.energy 0), playCostEnergy 0. COST FIX (adversarial): buy raised 12 -> 16 to match the Melanized Sheath engine it replaces, so this hard-counter (network-wide immunity + 1 cure/round) is a real investment and does not trivially nullify the entire mould threat for a cheap install. repay 3 (defense/common band). Pre-emptive: strong bought BEFORE clouds arrive on mould-heavy maps; a trap if bought late or on ant/worm-only maps where it idles.
